title: feat(types)!: retire ObjectChartSchema xAxisField / yAxisFields / aggregation on the object-chart node (objectui#10608)
body:
Fixes #10608
Clause-②: yes

## What changes

`ObjectChartSchema.xAxisField`, `yAxisFields` and `aggregation` are retired from the `object-chart` node on both published faces (ADR-0049). They are the LIST-VIEW chart block's vocabulary; the list-view relays translate that block before they compose an `object-chart` node, and nothing on the node's own render path reads them.

- **TS face** (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`): each member is now `?: never`, with a docblock that names the spec spelling and a `@deprecated` tag.
- **zod mirror** (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`): each member is a `retirementTombstone()`, so one guidance string is both the parse-time issue message and the `.describe()` metadata. The refusal is `invalid_type` at the key's own path and names the remedy: `xAxis: { field: 'status' }`, `yAxis: [{ field: 'amount' }]`, `aggregate: { field, function, groupBy }`.
- **Docblocks that taught the old spelling on this node are rewritten**: the interface docblock's `xAxisKey` bullet (which said the author-facing spelling on this node is `xAxisField`), the `xAxisKey` member doc, the `yAxis` member's note about `yAxisFields`, and the mirror's `xAxisKey` `.describe()` text. The interface docblock gains a short section on the retirement.
- **Changeset**: `minor` for `@object-ui/types`, with the breaking semantics stated. It is not `major`, because of the version-alignment rule.
- **Pin**: `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-chart-legacy-axis-keys-retired-10608.test.ts`.

**Precedent followed.** This follows the package's `?: never` + `retirementTombstone()` convention (`tombstone.zod.ts`). The nearest case is `ChatbotSchema.userAvatar` / `height` (objectui#7703, pinned in `chatbot-dark-keys-retired-7703.test.ts`): a dead spelling that sits beside a live one is refused, with the live one as the remedy. `ObjectKanbanSchema.groupField` (objectui#7322) is the other node-local case. Deleting the members was not the route. `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`, so an undeclared key is KEPT, not refused. Pin block (d) measures that on a misspelling.

## Measured before retiring (the card's stop condition)

The stop condition was a real producer that writes these keys ON an `object-chart` node. **None was found.**

**H1, declaration.** Confirmed on `origin/main` `5c61e5241`, the branch point. main had moved past the dispatch's `f9c06ef6a`, but this block is unchanged. The three members are on the TS interface and on the mirror, and the docblocks cited above teach the old spelling.

**H2, no reader. Measured with a render probe, not a grep.** The probe was a throwaway test file, deleted and not committed. It used a real `SchemaRenderer` with the package's own registrations and mocked `AdvancedChartImpl` to capture its props. The static rows were `status: open, n: 3` and `status: done, n: 5`.

| node | reached the chart | `xAxisKey` prop | `series` prop | refusal | data-source calls |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xAxisField: 'status'`, `yAxisFields: ['n']`, `aggregation: 'sum'`, static `data` | yes | none | none | none | none |
| CONTROL: `xAxis: { field: 'status' }`, `yAxis: [{ field: 'n' }]`, static `data` | yes | `status` | `dataKey: 'n'` | none | none |
| the same three legacy keys + `objectName: 'task'` | no | — | — | `chart-missing-category-axis` | `find` once |
| CONTROL: `aggregate: { field: 'n', function: 'sum', groupBy: 'status' }` + `objectName: 'task'` | yes | `status` | not passed | none | `aggregate` once |

I also read `normalizeChartSchema`'s axis and series sections in full. It resolves the category from `xAxisKey`, then `xAxis.field`, then a bare `xAxis` string, and it derives series from `yAxis[].field`. It names none of the three keys. In the non-test sources of `plugin-charts`, `components`, `react` and `core`, the three names appear only in comments.

**H3, producers.**
- **In-repo `object-chart` composers**: app-shell `ObjectView` (both chart branches), plugin-view `ObjectView`, plugin-list `ListView`, `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout`. Each one translates the keys, and none spreads them onto the node it builds. The two dashboard sites do spread `chartConfigPresentation(widget.chartConfig)`, but that function's whitelist (read in `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts`) emits none of the three.
- **The `object-chart` registration's `inputs`** advertise none of the three.
- **`examples/**`, `content/**`, `apps/**`, `skills/**`**: there are zero hits for `xAxisField` or `yAxisFields`. The `aggregation` hits belong to the report schema's field aggregation and to the grid's `aggregations`, not to this node. `skills/**` teaches none of the three on `object-chart`, so no governed row is split out.
- **objectstack `main` `16c5a33`**: the three showcase pages that build an `object-chart` / `ObjectChart` write `dataset` / `dimensions` / `values`, `yAxis: [{ field, stepSize }]`, and `xAxis={{ field }}` with `aggregate`. They write none of the three keys. The only `xAxisField` / `yAxisFields` hits are spec, lint and doc text about removing the keys from list charts and dashboard widgets.
- **hotcrm `main` `2f7b232`** (shallow clone): zero hits for `xAxisField`, `yAxisFields`, `object-chart` or `ObjectChart`. The positive control, `chartType`, does hit.

**H4.** `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema` is in `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS` (`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`). This diff adds no spec symbol reference and removes no spec crossing.

**H5.** The door is `safeValidateSchema`. The pin asserts the refusal there by code + path, and checks that the message carries the remedy.

**H6.** No census row moved. `object-chart-undeclared-keys-8885`, `widget-schema-anchors-7946` and `zod-mirror-parity` read the mirror's shape keys, and the tombstones stay declared. All three pass unchanged.

## Verification, at `856ecc953`

**Reverse verification.** The fix was committed first. I then checked out `objectql.ts` and `objectql.zod.ts` from the base `5c61e5241` and confirmed the change on disk: the tombstone text had 0 hits and `xAxisField: z.string()` had 1 hit in the mirror; `xAxisField?: never` had 0 hits and `xAxisField?: string` had 1 hit in the interface.
- The pin went **12 failed / 11 passed**. The failures were the 8 refusal cases, the 3 message-equals-describe rows and the vocabulary row. The declared-key rows, the lit controls, the passthrough control and the list-view control stayed green.
- `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exited 2 with 6 errors: 3 TS2344 on the `Equal` assertions and 3 TS2578 for unused `@ts-expect-error` directives.
- I restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. Both blob hashes equal HEAD's, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Cross-package check against the rebuilt `.d.ts`.** After the dependency-closure build, a temporary file in plugin-charts typed `xAxisField: 'status'` on an `ObjectChartSchema` literal. It failed with TS2322 ("Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'"), and the `xAxis: { field }` control line compiled. The file was then removed and the tree is clean.

**Consumers** (all DOWNSTREAM of `@object-ui/types`). Their dependency closures were built first with `turbo run build --concurrency=2`.

| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` | 241 files / 5300 tests passed |

| `pnpm --filter` plugin-charts, plugin-view, plugin-dashboard, plugin-list `run type-check` | exit 0, all four |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` | 81 files / 957 tests passed |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/` | 51 files / 485 tests passed |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` | 136 files / 1281 tests passed |

**Gates** (each exit code captured before any pipe):

| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (the 4 paths) | 0, NOT GOVERNED |
| `pnpm check:component-surface-parity` · `check:designer-field-key-parity` · `check:doc-types` · `check:handler-key-reads` · `check:prompt-keys` · `check:installed-pin-claims` · `check:action-forward-parity` · `check:registry-bare-names` · `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:unreferenced-sources` | 0 each |

The ESLint run was narrowed. The population is the repository-root `eslint.config.js`; there is no package-level config under `packages/types`. The `--format json` output counted 3 files. The config has no `projectService` / `parserOptions.project`, so type-aware linting is off, and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

**NOT MEASURED: the Spec Main Shape Gate.** Reason: running it locally needs `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main` as a tarball, plus a virtual-store injection and a typecheck of the whole repo. The only objectstack checkout here is shared and has no built spec. This diff adds or moves no spec symbol reference, only three local members. The gate's workflow runs on every pull request without a paths filter, so CI takes the reading.

## Acceptance notes

- **The list-view carriers keep these names. That is deliberate and out of scope.** app-shell and plugin-view `ObjectView` and plugin-list `ListView` still read `xAxisField` / `yAxisFields` / `aggregation` from a list view's chart config and translate them. On the authoring door, the spec's `chart` block (dataset-only) already refuses them, and the legacy `options.chart` bag admits them. Pin block (e) holds that boundary as a control. Whether that legacy path should also be retired is a separate question. Carrier: none named.
- **One reading differs from the card.** The card's reproduction said the `objectName` variant drew the refusal with 0 leaf calls. My probe saw the same refusal after one `find` call. That does not change the verdict (the legacy keys still aggregate nothing and bind no axis), and it is recorded here rather than chased.
- The `aggregation` refusal lists the spec's `function` vocabulary in its message. Pin block (c) re-derives that list from `ChartAggregateSchema` on every run, so the prose cannot drift from the spec silently.
- **Overlaps.** main had not moved from the branch point `5c61e5241` when this PR was opened. objectui#10710 edits the same two files at `ObjectDataTableSchema` and the import line, and this PR's hunks are the `ObjectChartSchema` block only. objectui#10584 is held serial behind this card on the same block.
- The changeset states the producer census as a one-time reading recorded here. It is not a live count.
